# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Palette ramps and brand — 30 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 10 tokens; Radius — 4 tokens; Layout — 6 tokens; Type scale — 13 tokens; Duration — 4 tokens; Easing — 2 tokens.

## Color · Palette ramps and brand

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--nodo-carbon, #101010);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" or "signal" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from that theme’s column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--nodo-carbon, #101010);   /* the dark theme’s value */
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #101010;
```

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 700 144px/0.95 "Space Grotesk", Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.055em;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-display); letter-spacing: -0.055em;
font-family: var(--font-display);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line, italic, letter spacing | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display` | `.display`, `--text-display` | 144px / 0.95, letter-spacing -0.055em | 700 | `display` | Desktop até 144 px · Mobile 48 px. Hero e manifesto, poucas palavras. --type-hero: clamp(3rem, 9.2vw, 9rem). |
| `h1` | `.h1`, `--text-h1` | 96px / 1.08, letter-spacing -0.055em | 700 | `display` | Desktop 96 px · Mobile 44 px. Título principal. --type-h1: clamp(2.75rem, 6.4vw, 6rem). |
| `h2` | `.h2`, `--text-h2` | 72px / 1.08, letter-spacing -0.055em | 700 | `display` | Desktop 72 px · Mobile 36 px. Título de seção. --type-h2: clamp(2.25rem, 5vw, 4.5rem). |
| `h3` | `.h3`, `--text-h3` | 40px / 1.08, letter-spacing -0.055em | 700 | `display` | Desktop 40 px · Mobile 24 px. Título de projeto. --type-h3: clamp(1.5rem, 2.8vw, 2.5rem). |
| `body-lg` | `.body-lg`, `--text-body-lg` | 22px / 1.6 | 400 | `body` | Body Large — Desktop 22 px · Mobile 18 px. Introdução. --type-body-lg: clamp(1.125rem, 1.5vw, 1.375rem). |
| `body` | `.body`, `--text-body` | 16px / 1.6 | 400 | `body` | Body — 16 px. Texto corrente. |
| `small` | `.small`, `--text-small` | 14px / 1.6 | 400 | `body` | Small — 14 px. Descrição curta. |
| `mono-label` | `.mono-label`, `--text-mono-label` | 12px / 1.4, letter-spacing 0.07em | 400 | `mono` | Mono Label — 12 px. Metadado editorial (text-transform: uppercase). |
